# Network360 Release

June 13, 2025

The production release took place after 3:00 p.m. CDT, 6/13/2025.



This Network360 release includes various fixes for Create a List, Compare Networks, Rank Networks, and more. 

# Fixes

### Create a List

Now, when the criteria includes address confidence level the Provider List appears correctly (instead of an error). 



### Compare Networks

Fixed an issue where the report would fail when the user runs multiple analyses at the exact same time.  



### Rank Networks

Now, when you can see the names of the providers who are not in one of the networks within your ranking by clicking on the linked number in the “Not in Network” column on the Ranking Details tab.  A popup will appear listing the provider names and their specialty. 

 

### Provider Profile

Now, the popups on the provider profile page appear correctly. This includes the provider location, bed counts (for a hospital profile), and resource (for a hospital profile).  



Now, the user can successfully remove a provider location tag. 



### User Profile

Now, you can edit a user profile and save it successfully.
